chapter: Money, radio and Sam Morgan's band
title: The WTPS radio show sponsored by Regal beer
summary: Allen recalls hearing Robinson's band on WTPS; they played for the beer sponsor with Charlie Hamilton and Cuckoo for about a year and a half.
